observations.why: The 'we' pronoun enacts communal-sharing — an undifferentiated collective body making a shared decision, not an individual commanding or transacting.
The justification is framed entirely as proportional cost-benefit — performance gain and cost reduction — the proportionality logic of market-pricing.
The arrow notation frames the migration as a proportional substitution — one technology exchanged for another on cost-benefit grounds, continuing the market-pricing logic.
Quantified performance gain restates the proportionality calculus — the benefit side of the cost-benefit exchange.
A fixed deadline imposed on the migration enacts authority-ranking — a temporal mandate that binds the collective to a rank-set schedule.
